description: Cancels an existing booking. Required: `bookingId` (from `list_bookings`) and the boolean `confirmed`; optional `reason`. This is a two-step safety flow: calling with `confirmed:false` does NOT cancel and returns only a 'not confirmed' acknowledgement (it does NOT return fees or refund amounts — read those first from `get_booking_details`); call again with `confirmed:true` to actually submit the cancellation. On success the response includes `cancellationFee` + `cancellationFeeCurrency` when the supplier reported a charged fee (absent means none was reported, not zero); refunds are processed separately. When the cancellation is not accepted, `failureReason` is one of `NOT_FOUND`, `AFTER_CHECK_IN`, `NOT_CANCELLABLE_STATUS`, `SUPPLIER_NOT_CONFIRMED` (submitted, under review: do not rebook or retry) or `ERROR` (not processed: the booking was not cancelled; try again later or contact support). Needs a registered LockTrip account session; guest sessions cannot cancel bookings. Without a signed-in session, pass the user's `email` instead: LockTrip emails them a sign-in link to their bookings on locktrip.com, and the result has `magicLinkSent: true` (nothing is shown or changed in this chat). Returns `success` and a `message`. This is a destructive, terminal action — confirm with the user before calling with `confirmed:true`.

email.description: The user's LockTrip account email. Needed only when there is no signed-in session: LockTrip then emails that address a sign-in link to the user's bookings on locktrip.com (the bookings are not shown in this chat).
